extracted.stage: Ongoing financial remedy proceedings, hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Crossley Family Law enquires about £15,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing financial remedy proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £671,000 and a hearing is listed for 17 October.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client regarding funding for her financial remedy proceedings. We have logged the details you provided, including the £15,000 sought, the approximate £671,000 in matrimonial assets and the hearing listed for 17 October. To progress a review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, your client's details and current asset position, a breakdown of the costs the funding would cover, and details of the assets available as security. A member of the team will come back to you once the file has been reviewed; nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding can be offered or on what terms.
